assumptions: Calculated from the repository provisional rough boundary geometry; not suitable for official area claims and must be recalculated when official geometry is released.
Agent-generated conceptual footprint for package topology and design discussion; not an existing-building survey or approved development quantity.
Derived from agent-generated conceptual green-space geometry within a provisional rough boundary; not an existing or statutory green-space ratio.
Derived from agent-generated conceptual public-space geometry within a provisional rough boundary; not an existing or statutory public-space ratio.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site boundary are not present in the public site package.

primary_task_completion_ratio.formula: service events meeting the frozen primary-task completion definition / all eligible service events
primary_task_completion_ratio.reason: No field baseline, eligible-event definition or trial observation is available.

result_closure_ratio.formula: tasks completing the agreed observation period without sustained recurrence / tasks entering observation
result_closure_ratio.reason: No selected problem class, recurrence rule, observation period or task record exists.

response_closure_ratio.formula: due formal tasks receiving a lawful response within the committed time / all due formal tasks
response_closure_ratio.reason: No formal-task workflow or commitment time has been established.

frontline_workload_index.formula: trial-period frontline labor minutes per completed comparable task / baseline-period labor minutes per completed comparable task
frontline_workload_index.reason: No frontline time-on-task baseline has been completed.

complaint_rate_ratio.formula: complaints per eligible service event during trial / corresponding baseline rate
complaint_rate_ratio.reason: No comparable service-volume and complaint baseline exists.

human_fallback_success_ratio.formula: failure drills restoring authorized human or fixed-rule service within the committed condition / all drills
human_fallback_success_ratio.reason: No operating service, fallback protocol or drill exists.

accessible_service_completion_ratio.formula: valid accessibility-service requests meeting the frozen minimum-service definition / all valid requests
accessible_service_completion_ratio.reason: No selected site, voluntary request process or minimum-service baseline exists.

public_rule_comprehension_ratio.formula: independently sampled users correctly identifying where to go, who is responsible and what to do during an exception without an app / all valid sampled users
public_rule_comprehension_ratio.reason: No public-interface prototype or field comprehension test has been completed.

independent_evidence_coverage_ratio.formula: declared core metrics reproducible by the appointed independent evaluator / all declared core metrics
independent_evidence_coverage_ratio.reason: No independent evaluator or evidence protocol has been appointed.

data_export_verification_ratio.formula: required data objects exported in the agreed format and successfully read in an alternative environment / all required objects
data_export_verification_ratio.reason: No platform, export specification or migration drill exists.
